objective: Find September's harvest candidates: write trades/proposed/harvest-2026-09-30.json — every open lot at an unrealised loss at the 2026-09-30 prices, with the loss and whether the lot is long-term — as candidates a program found.
contribution: The first half of a harvest, which is arithmetic: where the losses are. The second half — whether a loss is worth harvesting against its costs, and the replacement from the ticker's exchangeable set — is the harvest contract's (#124) and is not asked of this unit.

fixed.subject: the lots
fixed.decision: The open lots are lots/lots.csv, current to 2026-09-30, and are not changed by this unit; a candidate names one of them, in the shares it holds.

fixed.subject: the tax parameters
fixed.decision: The rates, the long-term cutoff and the wash-sale window are tax.json; the jurisdiction is the one it declares, and the rules are its rules.

fixed.subject: candidates only
fixed.decision: Every lot whose value at the 2026-09-30 prices is below its cost is a candidate, with no threshold and no benefit-versus-cost judgment; nothing in the file is a trade, and nothing is written under trades/pending/.

fixed.subject: trades/executed/
fixed.decision: The record of what was traded is the person's; a unit never writes there.

expectedEvidence.description: run_tests: the portfolio's own suite passes at the committed revision — every candidate is an open lot at an unrealised loss at the date's prices, with the loss as the arithmetic says
run_checks: the static checks pass and the protected prefixes are untouched
